// Supabase Edge Function: sends each device today's research topic at the time it chose.
// GENERATED by scripts/build-push-function.mjs from src/lib/daily-topic.ts and src/data/library-topics.json.
// Do not edit by hand; edit those files and run: node scripts/build-push-function.mjs
//
// Secrets (Edge Functions → Secrets): VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY, VAPID_SUBJECT (mailto:you@…), CRON_SECRET.
// SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are provided by Supabase. Called every 15 minutes by pg_cron (supabase/push.sql).
import webpush from "npm:web-push@3.6.7";
import { createClient } from "npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2";

/*__SHARED__*/

const TOPICS: Topic[] = flatten(/*__TOPICS__*/);

Deno.serve(async req => {
  if (req.headers.get("x-cron-secret") !== Deno.env.get("CRON_SECRET")) return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403 });
  webpush.setVapidDetails(Deno.env.get("VAPID_SUBJECT") ?? "mailto:hello@example.com", Deno.env.get("VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY")!, Deno.env.get("VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY")!);
  const sb = createClient(Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!, Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!, { auth: { persistSession: false } });
  const { data: subs, error } = await sb.from("push_subscriptions").select("*").eq("enabled", true);
  if (error) return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  const now = new Date();
  let sent = 0, removed = 0, failed = 0;
  for (const s of (subs ?? []) as (Sub & { p256dh: string; auth: string })[]) {
    const { due, date } = isDue(s, now);
    if (!due) continue;
    // the topic the person switched to today, if they did; otherwise the day's own topic
    const { data: own } = await sb.from("settings").select("value").eq("user_id", s.user_id).eq("key", "deen:topic").maybeSingle();
    const v = own?.value as (Topic & { date: string }) | undefined;
    const topic = v && v.date === date ? { cat: v.cat, title: v.title } : pickTopic(TOPICS, date);
    try {
      await webpush.sendNotification({ endpoint: s.endpoint, keys: { p256dh: s.p256dh, auth: s.auth } },
        JSON.stringify({ title: "Today’s research topic", body: `${topic.title} · ${topic.cat}`, url: "/?open=deen/library", tag: "daily-topic" }),
        { TTL: 6 * 3600 });
      await sb.from("push_subscriptions").update({ last_sent: date }).eq("endpoint", s.endpoint);
      sent++;
    } catch (e) {
      const code = (e as { statusCode?: number }).statusCode;
      if (code === 404 || code === 410) { await sb.from("push_subscriptions").delete().eq("endpoint", s.endpoint); removed++; }
      else failed++;
    }
  }
  return Response.json({ sent, removed, failed });
});
